<li>Visit <a href="https://anilist.co/settings/developer" rel="nofollow">https://anilist.co/settings/developer</a></li>

<li>Fill in the application details</li>
<li>Set redirect URL to: <code>https://your-domain.com/api/auth/callback/AniListProvider</code></li>
<li>Copy your <strong>Client ID</strong> and <strong>Client Secret</strong></li>
</ol>

<p dir="auto">This project is designed to teach:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>✅ <strong>API Integration</strong>: How to work with multiple anime APIs</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Data Mapping</strong>: Transform data from different sources into unified format</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Authentication</strong>: Implement OAuth with NextAuth.js</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Streaming</strong>: Handle HLS streams and CORS issues</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Caching</strong>: Optimize performance with Redis</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Database Design</strong>: MongoDB schema for user data</li>
<li>✅ <strong>Next.js Best Practices</strong>: API routes, middleware, SSR</li>
<li>✅ <strong>React Patterns</strong>: State management with Zustand, component composition</li>
